Subject: FinPay - Stakeholder map & MAP (next steps)

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to help keep momentum. Please confirm any changes and add any missing stakeholders.

Key points we heard:
- Primary use case: invoice processing assistant + extraction for reconciliation.
- Decision criteria: unit cost (tokens), latency (SLO for <300ms median for 1–2k token requests), data residency and security controls.
- Pilot goals: validate latency at scale and ensure no PII persists after inference.

Proposed MAP (draft milestones):
1) Internal demo (Redwood demo + SE deep dive) — target week of Mar 8 (schedule 60–90m).
2) Security questionnaire + evidence exchange — week of Mar 15 (security lead to review).
3) Procurement/terms review — target Mar 22–26 (PO / purchase order).
4) Pilot kickoff (sandbox integration) — week of Apr 5.

Open asks for you: please confirm the economic buyer + finance contact, procurement contact for PO discussions, security/legal reviewer, and any hard dates for budget/quarterly approvals. Also confirm whether FinPay requires an on-prem or VPC deployment for pilot.

I've attached a draft MAP (v1) and the format we usually use — will update based on your feedback.

Attachments: 20260302-FinPay-MAP-v1.pdf (application/pdf - 48KB)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning on dates.

Best,

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and clear MAP. A few updates from our side:

- Economic buyer: Sofia Mendes, CFO (cc'd here).
- Procurement: initial intake goes to procure@finpay.com; procurement lead for PO is Roberto Silva (I will loop him in once we have the MAP finalized).
- Security/legal: Anika Rao (Head of Security) is the reviewer for questionnaires; I copied her below.
- Decision criteria (prioritized): 1) Cost per token (TCO), 2) Latency at scale, 3) Data residency & encryption, 4) Support for our compliance requirements (SOC2 + audit logs).

Timeline notes: Sofia wants budget sign-off in the week of Mar 22, so if procurement can have an approved PO by Mar 25 that would be ideal. We prefer a VPC deployment for the pilot (data residency).

I'll attach the security questionnaire we typically send vendors so you can pre-populate. Also happy to meet for the SE demo — available Mar 9 or Mar 10 afternoons PT.
